Maria Ioannou
Head of Product
maria.ioannou@example.com · +1-555-027-2727 · Nicosia, Cyprus
Hybrid · Remote · EU Citizen · Notice period: 30 days
SUMMARY
Maria Ioannou is a principal Head of Product based in Nicosia, Cyprus, with 14 years of total experience. Her
expertise encompasses product strategy, roadmapping, agile methodologies, team leadership, data analytics,
and user research. She has held leadership roles across technology, software, and information technology
industries.
SKILLS
Product Strategy (14 years) · Roadmapping (12 years) · Agile Methodologies (14 years) ·
Team Leadership (10 years) · Data Analytics (10 years) · User Research (11 years)
EXPERIENCE

Industry: Technology
– Led product strategy and roadmapping initiatives as Head of Product.
– Exercised team leadership using agile methodologies within the technology industry.
Senior Product Manager — Levant Software 02/2016 – 02/2021
Industry: Software
– Managed roadmapping and user research projects as a senior product manager.
– Applied data analytics and agile methodologies in the software industry.
Product Manager — Kyrenia Systems 09/2012 – 01/2016
Industry: Information Technology
– Contributed to product strategy and user research as a product manager.
– Utilized data analytics within the information technology industry.

University of Cyprus
